title: [Informações do servidor] Hero Path (Paragons)(65lv.)
bodyHtml:
original thread(ru) - *link*

Paragon generators are available starting from level 65+ and can be used to continue character progression even at the maximum level.

Three types of available generators are sold by NPC Hero. At start generators have level 0.
  • Berserker Path Lv 0
    +0% attack
    +0% pure MAU damage
    +0% Isis attack
  • Hunter Path Lv 0
    +0 accuracy
    +0% block penetration
    +0% critical
  • Knight Path Lv 0
    +0 dodge
    +0% to MAU damage absorption
    +0% decrease critical
To raise/upgrade the level of the selected generator, you need to combine it with the item Training Certificate Emblem at NPC Hero.

Training Certificate Emblem can be obtained for completing a quest that is given from NPC Hero and is called a “Training Certificate”. The task for completing the quest is to reach level 66.

After reaching level 66, you can reset your level back to le el 65 in order to upgrade generator again and receive a reward for the second time itc. To reset the level, use a special potion that can be bought from NPC Hero.

This way you can upgrade all three available generators to the maximum level 5.

As a result, you will get a generator with the following properties:
  • Berserker Path Lv 5
    +25% attack
    +25% pure MAU damage
    +25% Isis attack
  • Hunter Path Lv 5
    +15 accuracy
    +15% block penetration
    +10% critical
  • Knight Path Lv 5
    +15 dodge
    +25% MAU damage absorption
    +10% decrease critical
For each step of level, the generator is given a certain number of effects:

+5% attack, +5% pure MAU attack, +5% Isis attack
+3 accuracy, +2% block penetration, +2% critical
+3 dodge, +5% MAU damage absorption, +2% decrease critical

EXP QUESTS AVAILABLE AT LEVEL 65
all quest can be taken from NPC Hero in HQ, and have cooldown 24 hours (daily quests)

>> Party quest “Deposit Information"
The reward is a 3% EXP Potion
Task:
Default task


>> Solo quest "Operation-N"
The reward is a 3% EXP Potion
Task:
Default task


>> Party quest “Captains"
The reward is a 3% EXP Potion
Task:
Kill 3 Kukra Vafer Captain
Kill 3 Naroom Crawler Captain
Kill 3 Cremul Snatcher Captain


>> Solo quest “Dangerous Creatures”
The reward is a 3% EXP Potion
Task:
Kill 10 Big Horn Cannival
Kill 10 Infected Ratmoth


>> Solo quest “New Horizons"
The reward is a 3% EXP Potion
Task:
Kill 5 Pathfinder
Kill 1 Bandit Captain
Kill 5 Hunter


Additional Quests:


>> Party Quest “Desert Task”
Can be purchased from NPC Hero for 15.000.000
The reward is a 3% EXP Potion
Task:
Kill 10 Trial Lunker


>> Solo quest “Dangerous Elves"
Can be purchased from NPC Dragon Knight for 500 Hunter Points
The reward is a 3% EXP Potion
Task:
Kill 6 Metal Elf Royal Guard


>> Solo quest “Snow Patrol"
Can be purchased from NPC Point Item (PvP merchant) for 5.000 PvP points
The reward is a 3% EXP Potion
Task:
Kill 30 Assassin BuilderB


>> Party Quest "Hero Path"
Can be purchased from Cash Shop for 333 Cash Shop Coins
The reward is a 5% EXP Potion
Task:
Kill 75 Caliana Crew
Kill 75 Caliana Atrock



* At level 65, you can level not only with the help of EXP Potions from quests, but also just killing monsters;
* Level 66 does not give an increase to the HP / FP / SP;
* Only one generator of the same type can work at the same time (for example, the Berserker Path Lv 4 and the Path of the Berserker Path Lv 5 does not stack, but all three different generators stack together);
* The effects of new Paragon generators can be stacked with old default generators.
